name: Gaze of C'Thun reveals stealth with Eyes of Eternity at full health (#10776)
contract: Eyes of Eternity 706188: "Healing an ally with Gaze of C'Thun now additionally reveals nearby stealthed
enemies for 8 seconds" (buff 807344). The reveal hook in AscensionCultistAbilities.cpp gated on the
effective heal that OnSpellHitResult receives, which Spell::EffectHeal reduces to the amount actually gained,
so a Gaze that lands on a full-health caster (all overheal) never revealed anything. The hook now also accepts a
heal whose target is the caster itself, even when nothing is gained; any other target, such as a full-health chain
target, still needs a non-zero effective heal, so the reveal stays one cast per Gaze. A level 43 Cultist with the
talent at full health casts Gaze of C'Thun 502138 on itself; the 520333 heal still lands (spell_heal_count) and
807344 must now be applied exactly once. Without the talent the same cast at full health must not apply it, so the
talent gate is unchanged. The injured-target behaviour is covered by cultist-gaze-eyes-of-eternity.

steps.label: Without the talent a full-health Gaze heal lands but reveals nothing
The full-health Gaze heal still lands
Eyes of Eternity reveals even though every point of the heal is overheal
